candidates.semantic_atom: Hybrid‑attention encoding: Feed the query and augmented passage embeddings into a Transformer encoder that applies shared full attention (global interactions) and dedicated masked attention (intra‑document interactions) in every layer, producing contextualized passage embeddings.

Improve reranking in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems by addressing both inference efficiency and the need for cross-passage reasoning, especially when evidence is scattered across passages and requires resolving coreference or structural context.
passage embeddings (pi): Fixed dense representations of candidate passages obtained from Contriever.

hybrid attention mechanism: Combines shared full attention (global cross‑passage) and dedicated masked attention (intra‑document) in each Transformer layer to jointly model inter‑ and intra‑document dependencies.

dedicated masked attention module: Masked multi‑head attention that restricts a passage to attend only to the query and to other passages from the same document, enabling fine‑grained coreference resolution and local coherence.
Embedding‑based reranking formulation and overall framework.
Design two complementary attention patterns that co‑exist in each layer: global and document‑local.
